name: api-route-always-needs-error-handling
hook: API routes with multiple async operations need try-catch around each stage
body:
When an API route performs multiple async operations (getPayload, auth, Promise.all), any unhandled exception will crash the route without returning a response, causing client fetches to hang indefinitely. Wrap each stage in try-catch to ensure always returns a response.

**Why:** Without error handling, if getPayload, payload.auth, or Promise.all throws, the route crashes without returning. The client fetch hangs forever because it never gets a response.

**How to apply:** When writing API routes that perform multiple async operations, wrap each operation (getPayload, auth, Promise.all) in its own try-catch block. Always return a response (even a 500) so the client fetch completes.
why: This bug manifested as permanently loading widgets because the route crashed without returning a response when an async operation failed.
